scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed verbatim scripts for: Greeting, Closing

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Dead Air Breach: Agent had 2 occurrences of >30s dead air (max gap 40s).

scorecard.name: Set proper expectations
scorecard.coaching: Clearly communicate the expected resolution time and steps to the customer, e.g., 'I'll check the system and get back to you within 2 minutes.'

scorecard.name: Provided the appropriate solution
scorecard.coaching: Instead of repeatedly suggesting a reboot, the agent should have explored other possible causes, such as checking the modem's firmware or suggesting a different internet service provider.

result.summary: Customer reports modem issue, agent suggests reboot and troubleshooting
